_comment: Known-blocked separability features for the corpus revision named below, recorded so the
gate can still report NEW regressions while the revision is blocked. This is a ratchet, not
an exemption: any feature that appears here that is not listed, or any listed feature whose
value gets worse, fails the check.
EMPTY, which is the only state a shippable revision may be in. v4 was blocked with 104
entries across five verticals; v5 clears all of them. Entries prefixed gold_exclusive: are
phrase counts, not AUCs -- a phrase recurring in >=20% of questions that reaches ZERO
distractor sessions. Deleting an entry without regenerating the corpus is the one thing this
file must never be used for.
